code:
curl -LsSf https://example.com/install.sh -o install.sh
less install.sh
sh install.sh     # only after you have read it
description: These commands download an installer, read it, and run it only after inspection.

steps.description: curl saves the installer script as install.sh instead of piping it to a shell.
less opens the saved script for inspection.
The final command runs the saved script only after you have read it.

title: Inspect an installer before running it
